Sentence (English): We have just replaced our BOSCH dishwasher with this new model.
Comments (English): [ Device meets our expectations ] || ---------------- || We have just replaced our BOSCH dishwasher with this new model. We are continuing with the brand because the previous one stayed with us for 29 years! So, it is without hesitation that we opted for this model that we appreciate for its silence, its baskets, very well designed, both for dishes and cutlery. It is much more "high tech" and consumes less water than the previous one, of course. and we hope that it will have as long a life! For the moment everything is going well, so we recommend this model
Comments (Original): [ Appareil conforme à notre attente ] || ---------------- || Nous venons de remplacer notre lave-vaisselle BOSCH par ce nouveau modèle. Nous continuons avec la marque car le précédent est resté avec nous pendant 29 ans !! Alors, c'est sans hésiter que nous avons opter pour ce modèle que nous apprécions pour son silence, ses paniers, très bien conçus, tant pour la vaisselle que les couverts. Il est beaucoup plus 'hight tech'et consomme moins d'eau que le précédent, forcément... et on espère qu'il aura une aussi longue vie !!! Pour l'instant tout se passe bien, alors nous recommendons ce modèle

Sentence (English): The machine is quiet and does an amazing job cleaning - HOWEVER.
Comments (English): [ Quiet, but food gets jammed alot in filter/ drain ] || ---------------- || The machine is quiet and does an amazing job cleaning - HOWEVER. This machine stopped working after 15 days. One day the machine had code "888" flashing on its display panel and no longer worked. I googled this code - and found it could be something liked a failed pump and could not see anything obvious in the unit itself ( ex: food jammed in the filter or something). When I called the Best Buy TOTAL TECH warrant center to get assistance/ request a service tech, the person had no guidance for any suggestions for the "888" code could be. The Best Buy TOTAL TECH person then indicated they would send a repair tech within 3 WEEKS so they could look at/repair my 15 day old dishwasher. Was disappointed about the long lead time to say the least. :-(This week the Best Buy Tech did come out for the scheduled service call. It turned out food had been stuck under the removable filter basket (which I could not see). Once this was removed and he flushed out the draining hose, the dishwasher was working again. Really hoping this machine will not turn into a maintenance headache. If you are going to buy this machine , I suggest you get the TOTAL TECH extended membership just in case.

The exact reason I tossed the previous unit (albeit just starting on this one). Nobody wants rust on their clean plates, food, etc. The entire top of a tine has been replaced with a hunk of rust. Really not impressed by this model. Especially not after reading the literature's definition of how they think drying works (someone needs to explain how condensation does/does not work to the engineers, because they seemingly have no clue).

Sentence (English): We purchased this during Covid.
Comments (English): [ Miss The Old Bosch ] || ---------------- || We purchased this during Covid. There weren't many models available so we picked this and waited three months for delivery. The problems are: . This dishwasher is not as good as the last Bosch we had for 18 years. It doesn't dry unless we run it on the auto cycle. It used to take 90 min to wash dishes now it takes 150 min. plus 30 more min. for sanitize to clean if you really want them dry. The silverware basket holds water, keeping the silverware wet and it not very easy to use. I liked the square basket we had to I could just lift it out and it would not be holding water. I found another basket that fit better and ordered it, still holds water. The rinse agent indicator has never worked. I have to guess when it's out. It's not easy to see the names on the front even with the lights on. I have to use a flashlight to read the words.

Sentence (English): (This review was collected as part of a promotion.)
Comments (English): [ It washes dishes like no other but.  ] || ---------------- || (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) I have owned this dishwasher for a good 7 or 8 years now. The washing capability is outstanding. likely better than all brands. There is a weakness that could have been improved though. The pump houses the heater. The heater is basically a printed conductor on a sheet similar to the heated grips on a snowmobile. It fails over time. I had to change it. The nice part was the code came up on the display and a google search told me what to focus on. It was correct. I ordered a new pump which was not cheap. Would have been nice if it was an inline heater similar to an automotive in line coolant heater and didn't require pulling out the dishwasher and putting it on its side to do the job but it was pretty simple. Sentence (English): I thought I could repair any appliance, until I tried to fix this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ It works great, until it doesn't. ] || ---------------- || I thought I could repair any appliance, until I tried to fix this dishwasher. To its credit, it ran great for 26 months, until just after the warranty expired. First it threw a PC error code, the vaguest error code ever devised. I purchased a service manual online for $30. I replaced the vane motor, the vane sensor and the associated seal for the motor. A new error popped up, 7C. That indicates a different part with the same name as parts that I just replaced. The first "vane" is the washer arm that moves back and forth in the bottom of the dishwasher. The other "vane" controls where water is directed. We've been without a dishwasher for the past week and a half, since every new parts take almost a week to be delivered, no matter who you order from. Samsung make great freezers, refrigerators and washing machines. Dishwashers? Never again. When I researched repairs for this model online, repairmen gave it a resounding groan and a "not the waterwall". Guess I should have researched the repair forums before purchasing.

Sentence (English): It is not suitable for built-in cabinets at home, so you can only choose countertops!
Comments (English): It is not suitable for built-in cabinets at home, so you can only choose countertops! Only suitable for 4 people, a family with 2-3 dishes per meal! The environment is good, must buy embedded, the bigger the better! Dishwashing performance, labor saving, saving personal time (not machine time)! After using it a few times, there will always be a layer of white things in the development. For some reason, it will not be obvious when using the strong mode! Take a while to explore! I chose the third generation, and the details of the workmanship are very ordinary! The switch panel feels a little cheap, and the damping is not very good! Hope to improve!
Comments (Original): 家里出柜不合适嵌入式的，只能选择台面式！只能适合4个人，一餐2-3个菜的家庭！环境可以，一定要买嵌入式，越大越好！洗碗性能，省力，省个人时间（不省机器时间）！用了几次，发展都会有一层白色的东西，不知道什么原因，用强力模式就会不明显！再用一段时间摸索下！我选的是三代，做工的细节很一般！开关面板，有些廉价的感觉，阻尼不是很好！希望改进！

Sentence (English): We have been using this new dishwasher for about a month and we love it!
Comments (English): [ LOVE this dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || We have been using this new dishwasher for about a month and we love it! First of all, it looks beautiful and doesn't seem to show fingerprints! But the BIG wins are how many dishes it will hold, and not having to pre-wash (or even rinse) dried on food before loading! We've never had a dishwasher that would clean dried on food from the dishes so we've been programmed to pre-wash dishes before loading. We nervously loaded dishes with dried on cheese, eggs, yogurt, etc. as a test, and this fabulous machine cleaned EVERY BIT of it and left the dishes sparkling! Even dried on cheese on the fork tines! Because of this, all of us load our dishes immediately and we don't end up with a sink full of dishes by the end of the day to pre-wash like we used to. We weren't sure we'd like the silverware "drawer" on the top rack - We're used to just throwing the silverware in the basket on the bottom rack. However, it only took one time to learn this is a time-saver too! We load the top silverware "drawer" so that all like items are together. Then to unload, you can grab all forks at once and put them away, then the spoons, and so on. This saves a tremendous amount of time when unloading the dishwasher that we did not anticipate! So, we now LOVE that too! The last thing that really wasn't a necessity, but is a luxury is how quiet this dishwasher is. We read reviews that addressed this, but didn't really think it would be this quiet! We truly can't hear it running AT ALL! Thank God for the awesome red light that shines on the floor indicating it's running or we'd be opening it constantly just to make sure! This is truly the BEST dishwasher we've ever had and we understand why it gets such amazing reviews. It was worth every penny and worth waiting several months for.

First of all, it looks beautiful and doesn't seem to show fingerprints! But the BIG wins are how many dishes it will hold, and not having to pre-wash (or even rinse) dried on food before loading! We've never had a dishwasher that would clean dried on food from the dishes so we've been programmed to pre-wash dishes before loading. We nervously loaded dishes with dried on cheese, eggs, yogurt, etc. as a test, and this fabulous machine cleaned EVERY BIT of it and left the dishes sparkling! Even dried on cheese on the fork tines! Because of this, all of us load our dishes immediately and we don't end up with a sink full of dishes by the end of the day to pre-wash like we used to. We weren't sure we'd like the silverware "drawer" on the top rack - We're used to just throwing the silverware in the basket on the bottom rack. However, it only took one time to learn this is a time-saver too! We load the top silverware "drawer" so that all like items are together. Then to unload, you can grab all forks at once and put them away, then the spoons, and so on. This saves a tremendous amount of time when unloading the dishwasher that we did not anticipate! So, we now LOVE that too! The last thing that really wasn't a necessity, but is a luxury is how quiet this dishwasher is. We read reviews that addressed this, but didn't really think it would be this quiet! We truly can't hear it running AT ALL! Thank God for the awesome red light that shines on the floor indicating it's running or we'd be opening it constantly just to make sure! This is truly the BEST dishwasher we've ever had and we understand why it gets such amazing reviews. It was worth every penny and worth waiting several months for.

Sentence (English): If you're in the market for a new dishwasher, I highly recommend the Bosch model SHPM88Z75N. I've had it for a few weeks now, and it's amazing.
Comments (English): [ Upgrade Your Dishwashing Game!  ] || ---------------- || If you're in the market for a new dishwasher, I highly recommend the Bosch model SHPM88Z75N. I've had it for a few weeks now, and it's amazing. The installation was straightforward, and I was able to do it myself with ease. Everything was clear and straightforward, and I had all the connections I needed since I was replacing an old dishwasher. However, watch the interactions for leveling, as it may be a bit confusing at first. One of the things that immediately stood out to me was how quiet it was. I used to only run the dishwasher overnight, but now I can run it anytime I want. My kitchen and living room are all in one room, and it's so quiet that I can even run it while watching TV, and I can't hear it at all. It's a massive improvement over my previous dishwasher. I was skeptical about the drying of this model since it doesn't have a heating element, but it does quite well. It's as good as my previous dishwasher that had a heating element. Obviously, there's nothing you can do if something has a lip and captures water. The only issue I had was with the strong jets throwing some plastic items around in the washer, but I found creative ways to place them, and the problem was solved. I also love the top rack for my knives and larger utensils, which I used to have to find creative places for in my previous dishwasher. This frees up a lot of space, allowing me to run much larger loads than before. I don't have to run multiple loads anymore, which is a big plus. The only possible negative thing I noticed is the timeout of the cycle when the door is opened. It takes a little getting used to having to hit start again to make sure it starts after being opened for a minute. Overall, the Bosch SHPM88Z75N is well worth the price for all the benefits it offers over my previous dishwasher. I'm already looking at more Bosch products to replace other items in my kitchen. If you're looking for a new dishwasher, I highly recommend giving this one a try.

Sentence (English): So the dishwasher is okay.
Comments (English): [ Okay dishwasher, terrible mounting ] || ---------------- || So the dishwasher is okay. It's fairly quiet and the cleaning is okay. The problem with cleaning and drying is that it requires a drying agent to be added. It seems that rather than developing better products to meet energy standards, you have to enable special features and include drying agents in order to make the dishwasher perform well. Where this dishwasher fails, overall fails, is in its mounting and stability. At first the dishwasher was installed with the side mount option as mentioned in the instruction manual with those flimsy little metal tabs that don't secure to anything beyond bend and twist to hold. I have a quartz countertop so the top installation wasn't an option. The old Maytag dishwasher lasted 5 years with side mountings without issues. This dishwasher has small feet. The weight of dishes on the door make the dishwasher tip and rotate around the side mounting points. Okay. Not ideal but could be better solved. I pulled the washer out, retrofitted the cabinet to have the steel bar installed underneath the countertop so I could add the top mount option. I bolted top mount brackets in place over using the bend and twist option. In the end, the washer was secured with 4 mounting points to the cabinets. The weight of the dishes on the door on a full load still causes the dishwasher to rotate. It rotated far less but it rotated non the less with 4 mounting points securing it. All available mounting options. The feet on the washer and tiny and smooth. They're not very large at all for holding weight and they tip/rock right over. So this dishwasher fails on stability with mounting and installation. Lastly, the interior arms are all plastic, no metal. I purchased this because I needed a replacement fast, without seeing one in person based on some consumer reviews online for cleaning performance to cost. That's my fault but I'm discouraged by the lack of metal for long term durability. The one positive is the filter is easy to clean. This isn't a model of dishwasher I would suggest. I've been using it for about a month and half and I'm discouraged with the purchase.

I hope it lasts 17 years like my old one.□□

Sentence (English): I've used it one time and it cleaned my dishes.
Comments (English): [ Good basic dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I've used it one time and it cleaned my dishes. However, I do rinse them before I load them. I replaced my 17 year old Whirlpool with this model, and it seems to be similar. It's just as loud and doesn't dry plastics well, but I load many plastics on their sides so I can fit more dishes. I would rather wash more dishes and dry a few plastics. My old dishwasher had the silverware in the door. I liked that it didn't take up loading space in the bottom rack, but this basket holds a lot more silverware and I don't have to find a way to wedge utensils into the top rack. I keep my silverware rack in the front so it's quicker to load than constantly pulling out the rack. I easily installed the dishwasher myself by removing the power cord, waterline and drain from my old one and attaching them to my new one. I did use the new drain hose that came with my unit for a garbage disposal, swapped it with my old drain hose, and it worked fine. There was a piece I had to buy that curved from my waterline to the machine because the water opening on the machine is much bigger than the waterline. I'm glad I didn't break the anchors at A or B like the manual said because I needed the entire length to mount my unit to my countertop. Overall, I'm satisfied and would buy this unit again. I hope it lasts 17 years like my old one.

Sentence (English): Hello, I recently bought a new house and replaced everything from the air conditioner to the refrigerator to Samsung products, and one of them is the dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Hello, I recently bought a new house and installed everything from the air conditioner to the refrigerator. ] || ---------------- || Hello, I recently bought a new house and replaced everything from the air conditioner to the refrigerator to Samsung products, and one of them is the dishwasher. These days, my second child was born not long ago, so my wife is focusing on taking care of the child and I am in charge of washing the dishes. We recently switched to a 12-person Samsung dishwasher, which is a huge help to our household chores. The design is also very pretty with the latest bespoke musk. In the first compartment, place flat items such as spoons, chopsticks, ladles, and scissors. In the second compartment, place things like cups, soup bowls, rice bowls, and plates. The third compartment is the largest and widest and places pots, beer glasses, wine glasses, and tumblers. I put the detergent in the detergent dispenser and wash the dishes very quietly, like doing laundry. Meanwhile, I spend my time alone. It's so good, I highly recommend it. I feel like I really have more time in my life~
Comments (Original): [ 안녕하세요 이번에 새집 마련을 하여 에러컨 부터 냉장고까지 전부 ... ] || ---------------- || 안녕하세요 이번에 새집 마련을 하여 에러컨 부터 냉장고까지 전부 삼성 제품으로 바꿨는데 그중 하나가 식기세척기 입니다.요즘 둘째아이가 태어난지 얼마되지 않아서 아내는 아이 보는데에 전념을 다하고 제가 설거지 담당을 하게 되었는데 이번에 삼성 식기세척기 12인용으로 바꿔 살림에 엄청 크나큰 도움이 되고 있습니다. 디자인도 최신 비스포크 사향으로 너무 이뻐요. 첫번째 칸에는 수저, 젓가락, 국자, 가위 이런 납작한 것들을 배치하고.. 두번째 칸에는 컵, 국그릇, 밥그릇, 앞접시 같은것을 배치 하고..세번째 칸에는 제일 크고 넓은 칸으로 냄비나 맥주잔, 와인잔, 텀블러 이런것들을 배치 하고나서전용세제 투입구에 전용세제를 넣고 빨래 돌리듯 ㅎㅎ 너무 조용하게 설거지 혼자서 다하고 그동안 저는 저만의 시간을 보낸답니다. 너무좋아요 적극 추천 드립니다.  정말 삶에 여유가 생긴것 같아요~

I do not like that when it beeps at the end of its cycle, that is not actually the end of the cycle as it still goes through the drying and sanitizing processes. And now today, one week after my 12 month warranty is up (of course), the tines are falling off and I'm told I'll need to finance repair or replacement myself as I'm outside of that warranty. The tines did not only starting rusting within the last week that the warranty had expired, it's been happening for a while now. Why would anything within a unit that is constantly wet. be permitted to rust at all. Pretty disappointed with this model overall, and this was the upgrade I'd purchased for myself from my first Samsung.

Sentence (English): My new Bosch dishwasher has been delightful and frustrating.
Comments (English): [ Bosch Dishwasher SHE3AR72UC ] || ---------------- || My new Bosch dishwasher has been delightful and frustrating. I love how quiet the machine is while running, and I love how clean and dry the dishes are when I open the washer. That offsets the slight irritations I've had with the rack tines, utensil trays, and the drying agent holder. First, I like to do things my way, so the way the tines are layed out to encourage you to load your washer a specific way irritates me. I would rather have consistantly spaced uniform tines all the way around so I can put items where I want to put them. I do not like the two utensil baskets at all. For one, they don't fit very well. It would be better if they were two slightly smaller baskets that would fit better in the allotted space or one larger basket that would fit in the space. Second, when you start filling the holes with utensils, it becomes difficult to see if a hole has already been filled or not. This takes too much time. And, third, there isn't much flexibility within a basket. The whole basket has to be either open or closed. I had my husband to cut one of the basket's tines to make three separate compartments so each compartment can be either open or closed. I have enjoyed the flexibilty this has given me in how I use the basket. Another issue I have (which I had on my older washer too) is that I have not found a way to pour the drying agent into the tiny space without it going where it shouldn't. I've even put my finger over the vent to keep it from being poured into it, but this has not worked either. I guess I just don't know how to pour the drying agent very well. I know that this is a new machine for me, and I will eventually get accustomed to the design. In the meantime, I will remain positive that I will adjust and thankful that I'm not handwashing my dishes!

Sentence (English): So our 6 year old Whirlpool died and a dishwasher is my favorite appliance.
Comments (English): [ In a pinch ] || ---------------- || So our 6 year old Whirlpool died and a dishwasher is my favorite appliance. I wasn't going to go long without! I went with this Bosch for a few reasons. It was in stock and I could could get it the next day. It had a stainless inside and was in my price range. The pros! It cleans and DRIES (even the plastics) really well. Better than my old whirlpool. It's relatively quiet. And I love the express, 30 minute cycle! The cons! I miss the small, slide out top rack in my Whirlpool. It was perfect for flat things. spatulas, knives, etc. I also prefer the utensil basket to be on the door like in my old Whirlpool. Gives me more space IN the actual dishwasher. The configuration of the "slats" in this Bosch, in addition to the utensil baskets, don't allow for a lot of dishes and pots and pans in the bottom rack. I end up hand washing a lot of my pots. which is probably better, but I hate it :). And this is picky, but I hate having to push the on/off button AFTER I run a cycle ane empty it. If I don't, it just blinks all day. Seems that after the door is closed, "off" would just turn off automatically, but it doesn't. Overall, it's a great dishwasher for the price. I was shocked at how much dishwashers are 6 years after my last purchase!

Sentence (English): I purchased this Bosch dishwasher to replace my 11 year old Bosch whose racks were rusted. (
Comments (English): [ Great, but not if you use wine glasses! ] || ---------------- || I purchased this Bosch dishwasher to replace my 11 year old Bosch whose racks were rusted. (New racks cost over $350 each! ) The new 300 series is as quiet as my old 800 series. It holds the same amount of dishes and looks very sleek. There is a \"however\" though. My only complaint is the ability to get my wine glassed clean in the dishwasher. The wine glasses do not fit easily in the top rack (even with the Bosch flimsy wine glass holder). I contacted Bosch, and the rep told me to remove the 3rd rack and lower the top rack. (I tried that before I called). Even with those rack adjustments, the glasses, sets are both 9.25\" and 7.5\", do not fit securely. With my old 800 series (not available), the wine glasses fit easily in the top rack. So, my only option is to put the glasses in the bottom rack standing straight up -- which of course causes water to pool on the stem bottoms. I love the feature of the 3rd rack and did not want to keep removing and reinstalling it anyway. If I knew about this loading \"defect,\" I would NOT have purchased this dishwasher. Next time, I'll take some glasses to the store and ensure they fit. (The rep at the store told me glasses would fit fine.) Oh, well.

Comments (English): [ Great, but not if you use wine glasses! ] || ---------------- || I purchased this Bosch dishwasher to replace my 11 year old Bosch whose racks were rusted. (New racks cost over $350 each! ) The new 300 series is as quiet as my old 800 series. It holds the same amount of dishes and looks very sleek. There is a "however" though. My only complaint is the ability to get my wine glassed clean in the dishwasher. The wine glasses do not fit easily in the top rack (even with the Bosch flimsy wine glass holder). I contacted Bosch, and the rep told me to remove the 3rd rack and lower the top rack. (I tried that before I called). Even with those rack adjustments, the glasses, sets are both 9.25" and 7.5", do not fit securely. With my old 800 series (not available), the wine glasses fit easily in the top rack.So, my only option is to put the glasses in the bottom rack standing straight up -- which of course causes water to pool on the stem bottoms. I love the feature of the 3rd rack and did not want to keep removing and reinstalling it anyway. If I knew about this loading "defect," I would NOT have purchased this dishwasher. Next time, I'll take some glasses to the store and ensure they fit. (The rep at the store told me glasses would fit fine.) Oh, well.

Sentence (English): This is a recommendation for beginners to the dishwasher ^ ^. A pretty cost-effective model with only the essential functions. -
Comments (English): This is a recommendation for beginners to the dishwasher ^ ^. A pretty cost-effective model with only the essential functions. - 80 degree high-temperature wash. : No 100 degree True Steam. I can't even wash dishes by hand at 80 degrees anyway. But I thought it didn't matter because it was clean. I recommend a model with True Steam for a house with a baby. - 2-tier dish loading. : I'm a newlywed couple with 2 people, but I definitely recommend it for 12 people. I usually only use the bottom tier, but I use the top tier when guests come. You can also adjust the tray height, so it's really good. I recommend a 3-tier model for a house with many people~. - Automatic door opening (no hot air drying) : This is the biggest reason I bought an LG dishwasher. I usually run the dishwasher for about 1 hour and 50 minutes, and you know LG's signature song? It makes the same sound as a washing machine, and the door opens slightly. When I hear that sound, I go and open the door wide. You can just think of it as natural drying~. Actually, I bought a hot air dryer before but didn't use it much. So I chose this model, but there is a difference of several hundred thousand won with a model that can dry hot air. Since I don't use it much, I boldly gave up. Please refer to this. If you look at the picture of the stainless steel pot, I turned it on the night before. I took a picture the next day around lunchtime, and it dried well without any major stains. - Easy operation, washing course (touch type). Standard: A course that is commonly used. Auto: Automatically adjusts time and temperature to wash. Rapid: A small amount of dishes in a short time. Powerful: Recommended for washing seasoned or oily dishes. Higher temperature + longer time than standard. Soaking: When you haven't washed the larvae or when things like rice are dried. - Other (feelings after using it). 1. I recommend rinsing the dishes with water and putting them in. If you just do that, they will all get stuck in the filter, so you will have to empty the filter anyway. 2. Choose the detergent that suits you by looking at the recommended reviews. (Ex. If you often eat fish or seaweed, buy a detergent that covers up water stains. If you don't like water stains, use a tablet detergent that includes rinse or use a separate rinse. ). 3. When washing small amounts, cut the tablet detergent in half. 4. Do not use on coated pans or rice cookers as the coating may come off. 5. It's a bit inconvenient to have to squat down to put in and take out, but it's much easier than washing dishes. - Overall: I'm glad I bought it. Free yourself from dishwashing hell~~!

Auto: Automatically adjusts time and temperature to wash. Rapid: A small amount of dishes in a short time. Powerful: Recommended for washing seasoned or oily dishes. If you don't like water stains, use a tablet detergent that includes rinse or use a separate rinse. ). 3. When washing small amounts, cut the tablet detergent in half. 4. Do not use on coated pans or rice cookers as the coating may come off. 5. Sentence (English): I bought it on Double Eleven last year and finally installed it.
Comments (English): I bought it on Double Eleven last year and finally installed it. I like it very much and the operation is very simple. The first time I used it, I was washing new dishes. I used the smart washing mode. It comes with an open door to dry. It took a total of 80 minutes. Before I had time to buy dishwashing salt, I used the small portion of finish that comes with the dishwasher. Dishwashing blocks and rinse aid, after 80 minutes of drying with the door open, I opened the door to check the drying status. The bowl was still hot and there was a little water. If I waited for the bowl to cool down completely, it should be dry a lot. Bought this one after reading a lot of reviews, so far it looks good. But the chopstick cage seems to be a bit high for the chopsticks, and it will block the spray arm. I don't know if my chopsticks are too long or I put them wrong. After sale is very good.
Comments (Original): 去年双十一买的，终于安装好了，非常喜欢，操作也很简单。第一次使用，洗的是新碗，用的是智能洗模式，自带了开门烘干，总共80分钟，还没来得及买洗碗盐，用了洗碗机自带的小份的finish的洗碗块和亮碟剂，80分钟开门烘干一结束，我就开门查看了烘干情况，当时碗还热着，有一点点水，如果我等碗全部冷却下来，应该会干很多。看了很多测评才买了这一款，目前看来很好。但是筷笼放筷子好像有点高了，会挡住喷淋臂，不知道是我筷子太长还是我摆放的不对。售后很好。

Comments (English): [ The dishwasher is a new world. I've been using it for about a month now, and I think it's a good purchase every day. I've been using it for about a month now, and I think it's a good purchase every day. Since there are 2 people + 3 cats, there are more cat bowls than human bowls, but you want to do the dishes after work, I want to do it. I think 400,000 won is worth living. I was surprised that the noise was loud when the water was drained 3-4 times in the middle, but other than that it seems to be fine. The more you use it, the more comfortable it becomes. Sentence (English): Before receiving the dishwasher, I watched a video comparing dishwashers on the market.
Comments (English): [ Good value dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Before receiving the dishwasher, I watched a video comparing dishwashers on the market. Compared to products from major companies, the brand recognition may be lower, but I chose the product because it seemed to be not much different in terms of performance. This is my second time using a dishwasher. When I used it almost 20 years ago, there was no automatic opening and the tray for putting products was inconvenient. Also, pre-washing was essential and there were no various courses, so I had a fixed idea about dishwashers. But when I used it this time, wow. It was a new world. Since everyone eats and cooks at home, there are a lot of dishes to wash each day, but I thought I could save about 30 minutes to an hour. Everyone lives near a subway station to save that much time, so I think I understand why they are called the 3rd generation aunt. There is almost no smell and the grease is cleaned very well. After eating, you just put them in one by one and turn it on, and the door opens automatically to prevent them from getting soggy. What I especially like is - The compartments for plates and cutlery are scientific. They are designed to be placed one by one for the user. - The design is not bad in silver. - The price is cost-effective. The bigger the dishwasher, the better. Even though we are a 3-person household, the 12-person one was just right. - The installation was friendly and explained the instructions. There are accessories. The installation time is about 2 hours. That's about it. In fact, during the process of receiving the dishwasher, the delivery was delayed unilaterally due to missing accessories, which was very frustrating. However, the installation technician and Coupang consultant were very considerate, so we were able to bring the schedule forward. And after receiving the friendly construction and finishing the piled up dishes at once, all the hardships disappeared? Still, I was quite anxious for a week, so I lowered the rating to 4. However, the quality of the product is good, so it is 4. Accessories include a manual and a detergent cup, and the detergent to be used first is not included, so it is better to buy a special detergent in advance! Another thing to be careful of is that wood or stainless steel can deteriorate, so it is better to familiarize yourself with the classification of what to put in and what not to put in. The amount is quite large. I put in a pan, a side dish, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, a ladle, and a side dish bowl, and there was still room. I think I know why the dishwasher is called an aunt. It feels like buying peace and time for my family with money? Although the delivery was delayed, the dishwasher itself has many functions and is convenient to use, so it's good! Personally, I recommend the built-in method over the standing method! Since each person's cabinet size is different, I recommend trying it out in advance. I hope this review was helpful! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Good value dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Before receiving the dishwasher, I watched a video comparing dishwashers on the market. Compared to products from major companies, the brand recognition may be lower, but I chose the product because it seemed to be not much different in terms of performance. This is my second time using a dishwasher. When I used it almost 20 years ago, there was no automatic opening and the tray for putting products was inconvenient. Also, pre-washing was essential and there were no various courses, so I had a fixed idea about dishwashers. But when I used it this time, wow. It was a new world. Since everyone eats and cooks at home, there are a lot of dishes to wash each day, but I thought I could save about 30 minutes to an hour. Everyone lives near a subway station to save that much time, so I think I understand why they are called the 3rd generation aunt. There is almost no smell and the grease is cleaned very well. After eating, you just put them in one by one and turn it on, and the door opens automatically to prevent them from getting soggy. What I especially like is - The compartments for plates and cutlery are scientific. They are designed to be placed one by one for the user. - The design is not bad in silver. - The price is cost-effective. The bigger the dishwasher, the better. Even though we are a 3-person household, the 12-person one was just right. - The installation was friendly and explained the instructions. There are accessories. The installation time is about 2 hours. That's about it. In fact, during the process of receiving the dishwasher, the delivery was delayed unilaterally due to missing accessories, which was very frustrating. However, the installation technician and Coupang consultant were very considerate, so we were able to bring the schedule forward. And after receiving the friendly construction and finishing the piled up dishes at once, all the hardships disappeared? Still, I was quite anxious for a week, so I lowered the rating to 4. However, the quality of the product is good, so it is 4. Accessories include a manual and a detergent cup, and the detergent to be used first is not included, so it is better to buy a special detergent in advance! Another thing to be careful of is that wood or stainless steel can deteriorate, so it is better to familiarize yourself with the classification of what to put in and what not to put in. The amount is quite large. I put in a pan, a side dish, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, a ladle, and a side dish bowl, and there was still room. I think I know why the dishwasher is called an aunt. It feels like buying peace and time for my family with money? Although the delivery was delayed, the dishwasher itself has many functions and is convenient to use, so it's good! Personally, I recommend the built-in method over the standing method! Since each person's cabinet size is different, I recommend trying it out in advance. I hope this review was helpful! Comments (English): [ Good value dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Before receiving the dishwasher, I watched a video comparing dishwashers on the market. Compared to products from major companies, the brand recognition may be lower, but I chose the product because it seemed to be not much different in terms of performance. This is my second time using a dishwasher. When I used it almost 20 years ago, there was no automatic opening and the tray for putting products was inconvenient. Also, pre-washing was essential and there were no various courses, so I had a fixed idea about dishwashers. But when I used it this time, wow. It was a new world. Since everyone eats and cooks at home, there are a lot of dishes to wash each day, but I thought I could save about 30 minutes to an hour. Everyone lives near a subway station to save that much time, so I think I understand why they are called the 3rd generation aunt. There is almost no smell and the grease is cleaned very well. After eating, you just put them in one by one and turn it on, and the door opens automatically to prevent them from getting soggy. What I especially like is - The compartments for plates and cutlery are scientific. They are designed to be placed one by one for the user. - The design is not bad in silver. - The price is cost-effective. The bigger the dishwasher, the better. Even though we are a 3-person household, the 12-person one was just right. - The installation was friendly and explained the instructions. There are accessories. The installation time is about 2 hours. That's about it. In fact, during the process of receiving the dishwasher, the delivery was delayed unilaterally due to missing accessories, which was very frustrating. However, the installation technician and Coupang consultant were very considerate, so we were able to bring the schedule forward. And after receiving the friendly construction and finishing the piled up dishes at once, all the hardships disappeared? Still, I was quite anxious for a week, so I lowered the rating to 4. However, the quality of the product is good, so it is 4. Accessories include a manual and a detergent cup, and the detergent to be used first is not included, so it is better to buy a special detergent in advance! Another thing to be careful of is that wood or stainless steel can deteriorate, so it is better to familiarize yourself with the classification of what to put in and what not to put in. The amount is quite large. I put in a pan, a side dish, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, a ladle, and a side dish bowl, and there was still room. I think I know why the dishwasher is called an aunt. It feels like buying peace and time for my family with money? Although the delivery was delayed, the dishwasher itself has many functions and is convenient to use, so it's good! Personally, I recommend the built-in method over the standing method! Since each person's cabinet size is different, I recommend trying it out in advance. I hope this review was helpful! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Good value dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Before receiving the dishwasher, I watched a video comparing dishwashers on the market. Compared to products from major companies, the brand recognition may be lower, but I chose the product because it seemed to be not much different in terms of performance. This is my second time using a dishwasher. When I used it almost 20 years ago, there was no automatic opening and the tray for putting products was inconvenient. Also, pre-washing was essential and there were no various courses, so I had a fixed idea about dishwashers. But when I used it this time, wow. It was a new world. Since everyone eats and cooks at home, there are a lot of dishes to wash each day, but I thought I could save about 30 minutes to an hour. Everyone lives near a subway station to save that much time, so I think I understand why they are called the 3rd generation aunt. There is almost no smell and the grease is cleaned very well. After eating, you just put them in one by one and turn it on, and the door opens automatically to prevent them from getting soggy. What I especially like is - The compartments for plates and cutlery are scientific. They are designed to be placed one by one for the user. - The design is not bad in silver. - The price is cost-effective. The bigger the dishwasher, the better. Even though we are a 3-person household, the 12-person one was just right. - The installation was friendly and explained the instructions. There are accessories. The installation time is about 2 hours. That's about it. In fact, during the process of receiving the dishwasher, the delivery was delayed unilaterally due to missing accessories, which was very frustrating. However, the installation technician and Coupang consultant were very considerate, so we were able to bring the schedule forward. And after receiving the friendly construction and finishing the piled up dishes at once, all the hardships disappeared? Still, I was quite anxious for a week, so I lowered the rating to 4. However, the quality of the product is good, so it is 4. Accessories include a manual and a detergent cup, and the detergent to be used first is not included, so it is better to buy a special detergent in advance! Another thing to be careful of is that wood or stainless steel can deteriorate, so it is better to familiarize yourself with the classification of what to put in and what not to put in. The amount is quite large. I put in a pan, a side dish, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, a ladle, and a side dish bowl, and there was still room. I think I know why the dishwasher is called an aunt. It feels like buying peace and time for my family with money? Although the delivery was delayed, the dishwasher itself has many functions and is convenient to use, so it's good! Personally, I recommend the built-in method over the standing method! Since each person's cabinet size is different, I recommend trying it out in advance. I hope this review was helpful! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as a Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): Truly as quiet as promised.
Comments (English): [ Run 2 full cycles if you want anything rinsed. ] || ---------------- || Truly as quiet as promised. But does not rinse well, or dry well, even with extended heated dry selected. No options for extra rinse or additional drying. We've started just running it twice (zero soap the second time), then letting it sit to dry overnight. The only way to get them clean and dry. Yes that's incredibly tedious, time consuming, and for a large family it would be simply impossible. It's also wasteful but what choice do we have. I suggest not using rinse aid, as it costs money and doesn't resolve or even slightly improve the above issues. We tried without rinse aid, with the normal amount, and with the setting to use extra. Haven't even had reason to try the steam setting so far. The drying features work quite well too, very little water left after the cycle. The interior light is nice and bright. The folding tines and adjustable racks all over make it quite easy to handle different loads. The WiFi feature is kind of cute. Lets you know on your phone when the dishwasher run is complete which I suppose can be useful in some situations. I have no idea why anyone would want to use WiFi to remote start the unit though, it does have a timer. The not so good. Installation was an extra pain because LG only provided hardware for mounting on the top (for wood/particle board countertops). The unit does have a couple of side mount brackets when you need to secure at the side (when you have a granite or similar countertop that you don't want to be putting screws into), but they are quite crappy and no proper size screws provided. Boo. Also this unit comes with a large rubber mat that gets installed over the water valves and under the door for sound insulation. It looks like a bit of an afterthought, only makes a modest difference on sound levels, and it makes the door very stiff to open completely. The lower rack will always tend to roll back into the dishwasher unless positioned carefully. It is very quiet when running, but when filling the water valves make a lot of noise. My old Samsung, which was horrible at cleaning, was a lot quieter during fill and didn't have this weird rubber insulating mat either. The large basket for utensils has a massive handle that really gets in the way of loading. Not the end of the world, just annoying. The racks roll well and have lots of adjustments, but the middle rack doesly always perfectly line up well with the rear water outlet (to power the sprayer attached to the middle rack). You have to make sure to push firmly to make sure the water connection to the rack mates well. Also, with 3 racks finding the right place for tall items can be a chore, but I think that's just the way it is with 3 rack units.All in all, it does excellent at washing dishes, but definitely some sore spots working with the unit.

Sentence (English): After 18 years of service, we decided to replace a previous GE Profile DW with this one.
Comments (English): [ Replaced a GE dishwasher with a GE ] || ---------------- || After 18 years of service, we decided to replace a previous GE Profile DW with this one. Quality and features were as advertised. This unit provided the features we wanted. We have only used it twice, but it appears to work very well. We self-installed in order to get the quality we wanted. Four bits of feedback worth noting:1. When delivered, a pair of deliberate scratches had been made across the front door.This had been done at the factory, prior to boxing. It penetrated the protective film, but we were able to buff out with abrasive pads.2. Top control design is barely compatible with any cabinet arrangement where countertop overhangs the faceframe (which would be most common) - the exact dimensions of this fit-up should be prominently featured in the product literature.3. Unless your DW is to be installed in a very oversized cabinet opening, the fit-up with respect to faceframe, countertop, leveling, and mounting bracket installation is the lion's share of the install effort. The dimensional relationship among these features and the door is a challenge to make work. Where the fit is closer (typical), the supplied trim is quite useless - and the rough fit between the tub flange layers made it all but impossible to press the trim on. I had to make my own.4. Considering wrench access, it makes more sense to install the water supply elbow to the incoming tubing/hose first, then tighten elbow hose-thread connection onto valve assembly later.

Sentence (English): I'm writing an evaluation of the Bosch Series 500 (SHPM65Z55N) that was installed at my home on 2 March 2023.I'll address the following aspects the dishwasher, easy of loading, cleaning performance, drying, noise levels, making default settings, and finally areas needing attention.
Comments (English): [ Patrick New SHPM65Z55N Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I'm writing an evaluation of the Bosch Series 500 (SHPM65Z55N) that was installed at my home on 2 March 2023.I'll address the following aspects the dishwasher, easy of loading, cleaning performance, drying, noise levels, making default settings, and finally areas needing attention. Some of my comments will reference the 52-page Bosch User's Manual.The new Bosch Series 500 dishwasher replaced my 15 year old KitchenAid that failed when the electronic controls failed requiring a costly repair. The old dishwasher set the standards by which I use to judge the new washer.Ease of Loading Loading the Bosch is significantly different from that of my old KitchenAid and will probably new users a month before becoming proficient. I like the Bosch method of loading knives, forks, spoons, etc. in the top rack. It facilitates loading the items in an ordered manner that makes it easy to quickly unload like items for storage in a drawer. I removed the two "baskets" to make room for more dishes and bowls. I haven't missed them. The fact that the Bosch Series 500 dishwasher does not have a dryer heating element is a major plus. Dropping heating element makes it energy efficient and it allows us to place plastic items in the large lower rack without fear that a high temperature coil will damage such items. Cleaning Performance The ability of the Bosch Series 500 dishwasher to effectively clean its contents is superior. It beats that of my old KitchenAid by a mile.Drying We use AutoAir as our default setting that produces satisfactory results. However, we now have a drying cloth handy whenever we unload the washer. Noise Levels The noise produced by this Bosch Series 500 is lower than that of the dishwasher it replaced. The noise from our new Bosch is so low that we depend on its red run light to check its run status. It is noteworthy that noise levels reported by various manufactures in the Consumer Report magazine are not obtained in a standard manner. Thus the manufacture's listed noise levels should be used only to compare levels for different washer models made my the same company. Making Default Settings Without a doubt, this is the most head-scratching effort of learning to use the washers covered by the User's Manual. Anything that could be done to make the process more reader efficient would be useful.Areas Needing Attention The User's Manual is significantly deficient in one area that should be corrected ASAP. That area is the starting procedure after all the default setting have been made and you're starting a new cycle after loading the cleaning agent and the liquid rinse aid. The washer will not start if the user does not pause a period of time between pressing the On/Off button and then pressing the Start button before shutting the washer door within 4-seconds after pressing the Start button. We have determined that it is necessary to pause at least three flashes of the control panel indicator lights before pressing the Start button and then shutting door without hesitation for the washer to start. If the user does not pause between pressing the On/Off and the Start button before shutting the door the red run indicator light will not come on and the washer does not start. The User Manual does not provide user guidance as to how to recover from this situation. Starting all over after pressing the On/Off button does not necessarily reset the washer. It is possible when trying various button pushing sequences after the washer doesn't start and to get a flashing red run indicator light. The section of the User's Manual on page 36 entitled Terminating the wash cycle (Reset) will not correct the flashing red run light situation. Also, following this procedure to recover from the flashing red light situation never results in the display reading 0,01. This can lead the casual user to believe that the washer is broken,It appears that the controls require pauses at some points of the start/recover process. I don't think all needed pauses are identified in the User's Manual.

Sentence (English): First the good, I am very impressed how well this cleans dishes.
Comments (English): [ The good and the bad ] || ---------------- || First the good, I am very impressed how well this cleans dishes. Had it for a couple months now and mainly just used the auto or normal settings and absolutely everything loaded comes very clean 19 times out of 20 even when some things are placed close together. Haven't even had reason to try the steam setting so far. The drying features work quite well too, very little water left after the cycle. The interior light is nice and bright. The folding tines and adjustable racks all over make it quite easy to handle different loads. The WiFi feature is kind of cute. Lets you know on your phone when the dishwasher run is complete which I suppose can be useful in some situations. I have no idea why anyone would want to use WiFi to remote start the unit though, it does have a timer. The not so good. Installation was an extra pain because LG only provided hardware for mounting on the top (for wood/particle board countertops). The unit does have a couple of side mount brackets when you need to secure at the side (when you have a granite or similar countertop that you don't want to be putting screws into), but they are quite crappy and no proper size screws provided. Boo. Also this unit comes with a large rubber mat that gets installed over the water valves and under the door for sound insulation. It looks like a bit of an afterthought, only makes a modest difference on sound levels, and it makes the door very stiff to open completely. The lower rack will always tend to roll back into the dishwasher unless positioned carefully. It is very quiet when running, but when filling the water valves make a lot of noise. My old Samsung, which was horrible at cleaning, was a lot quieter during fill and didn't have this weird rubber insulating mat either. The large basket for utensils has a massive handle that really gets in the way of loading. Not the end of the world, just annoying. The racks roll well and have lots of adjustments, but the middle rack doesly always perfectly line up well with the rear water outlet (to power the sprayer attached to the middle rack). You have to make sure to push firmly to make sure the water connection to the rack mates well. Also, with 3 racks finding the right place for tall items can be a chore, but I think that's just the way it is with 3 rack units. All in all, it does excellent at washing dishes, but definitely some sore spots working with the unit.

Sentence (English): After 18 years of service, we decided to replace a previous GE Profile DW with this one.
Comments (English): [ Replaced a GE dishwasher with a GE ] || ---------------- || After 18 years of service, we decided to replace a previous GE Profile DW with this one. Quality and features were as advertised. This unit provided the features we wanted. We have only used it twice, but it appears to work very well. We self-installed in order to get the quality we wanted. Four bits of feedback worth noting: 1. When delivered, a pair of deliberate scratches had been made across the front door.This had been done at the factory, prior to boxing. It penetrated the protective film, but we were able to buff out with abrasive pads. 2. Top control design is barely compatible with any cabinet arrangement where countertop overhangs the faceframe (which would be most common) - the exact dimensions of this fit-up should be prominently featured in the product literature. 3. Unless your DW is to be installed in a very oversized cabinet opening, the fit-up with respect to faceframe, countertop, leveling, and mounting bracket installation is the lion's share of the install effort. The dimensional relationship among these features and the door is a challenge to make work. Where the fit is closer (typical), the supplied trim is quite useless - and the rough fit between the tub flange layers made it all but impossible to press the trim on. I had to make my own. 4. Considering wrench access, it makes more sense to install the water supply elbow to the incoming tubing/hose first, then tighten elbow hose-thread connection onto valve assembly later.

They really dropped the ball on this one.
